purpose: One shared list of regions, markets and categories. Language editions, pricing zones, grant eligibility, CRM region tags and chat routing should all read from this file.

regions.label: Global
regions.definition: Open to applicants anywhere, subject to listed exclusions

country_groups.label: Low- and middle-income countries
country_groups.definition: World Bank low, lower-middle and upper-middle income economies. Resolve membership at build time from the World Bank country classification (updated each July).

country_groups.label: Least developed countries
country_groups.definition: UN list of least developed countries.

country_groups.label: ODA-eligible countries
country_groups.definition: OECD DAC list of ODA recipients.

country_groups.label: Sub-Saharan Africa
country_groups.definition: Union of east_africa, west_central_africa and southern_africa except SD.

country_groups.label: Commonwealth countries
country_groups.definition: Commonwealth of Nations members; several UK and Commonwealth programmes use this.

funder_types.label: Family philanthropy
funder_types.definition: Family foundations and family offices, including India family foundations.

funder_types.label: Corporate CSR
funder_types.definition: Company CSR budgets, including India Companies Act Section 135 spend.

funder_types.label: Feminist or identity-led fund
funder_types.definition: Women's funds, feminist funds, funds led by and for a specific community.

funder_types.label: Domestic government
funder_types.definition: National or state schemes for organisations in that country.

funder_types.label: Intermediary or regranter
funder_types.definition: Funds money from others, or acts as fiscal sponsor or equivalency route.

funder_types.label: Tech company programme
funder_types.definition: In-kind software, credits, discounts and tech grants from technology companies.

funder_types.label: Aggregator
funder_types.definition: Lists other funders' opportunities. Treat as a secondary source: confirm on the funder's own page.

funder_types.label: Network or association
funder_types.definition: Intelligence on who funds what; rarely funds directly.

funder_types.label: Diaspora philanthropy
funder_types.definition: For example US-based funders giving to Indian NGOs.

funder_types.label: Validation service
funder_types.definition: Verifies nonprofit status for tech programmes (Goodstack, TechSoup).

opportunity_types.label: Recoverable grant
opportunity_types.definition: Repaid only if the venture succeeds.

opportunity_types.label: Impact investment
opportunity_types.definition: Equity, quasi-equity or debt for social enterprises.

opportunity_types.label: Award or recognition
opportunity_types.definition: Visibility and network, small or no cash.

opportunity_types.label: Fellowship
opportunity_types.definition: Support for a founder or leader, often with organisational funding.

opportunity_types.label: Capacity-building programme
opportunity_types.definition: Cohort, training or mentoring without core funding.

opportunity_types.label: AI credits
opportunity_types.definition: Model or API credits from AI providers.

opportunity_types.label: Matching funds
opportunity_types.definition: Including payroll and employee giving matches.

opportunity_types.label: Tender or RFP (procurement)
opportunity_types.definition: Paid contracts. Internal business development only.

eligible_org_types.label: Registered nonprofit
eligible_org_types.definition: Trust, society, Section 8 company, 501(c)(3), registered charity, yayasan, OSC and equivalents.

eligible_org_types.label: Hybrid social enterprise
eligible_org_types.definition: Nonprofit and for-profit arms, or a CIC.

eligible_org_types.label: Consortium
eligible_org_types.definition: Applications must be made as a partnership.

themes.label: Nonprofit digital capacity
themes.definition: Funding or in-kind support for an organisation's own systems, data and tools.

registration_requirements.label: India FCRA registration
registration_requirements.definition: Needed for an Indian NGO to receive any foreign contribution, including from US diaspora funders.

registration_requirements.label: India 80G certificate
registration_requirements.definition: Lets Indian donors claim tax deduction; many CSR and HNI donors expect it.

registration_requirements.label: India CSR-1 registration
registration_requirements.definition: MCA registration required to receive CSR funds.

registration_requirements.label: NGO Darpan ID
registration_requirements.definition: NITI Aayog unique ID, required for most central government grants.

registration_requirements.label: US equivalency determination or fiscal sponsor
registration_requirements.definition: Route for non-US organisations to receive US foundation grants.

registration_requirements.label: Kenya NGO / PBO registration
registration_requirements.definition: NGOs Co-ordination Board / Public Benefit Organisations regime.

registration_requirements.label: EU Participant Identification Code
registration_requirements.definition: Needed to apply on the EU Funding & Tenders Portal.

registration_requirements.label: UNGM vendor registration
registration_requirements.definition: Needed to bid on UN tenders.

registration_requirements.label: Goodstack validation
registration_requirements.definition: Used by Google for Nonprofits and other tech programmes outside the US.

registration_requirements.label: Local legal registration
registration_requirements.definition: Some legal registration in the country of operation, type unspecified.

application_modes.label: Registration portal
application_modes.definition: Register once, then see or bid on notices.

application_modes.label: Marketplace listing
application_modes.definition: List the organisation or project to receive support.

deadline_patterns.label: Ad hoc calls
deadline_patterns.definition: Calls appear without a predictable cycle.

fetch_methods.label: Page watch
fetch_methods.definition: Fetch the listing page and diff it.

fetch_methods.label: Newsletter
fetch_methods.definition: Subscribe a shared inbox and parse.

fetch_methods.label: Manual review
fetch_methods.definition: A person checks on the cadence.

outputs.label: Public directory
outputs.definition: Verified opportunities for NGOs and social enterprises, published through the reviewed GitHub flow.

outputs.label: Internal business development
outputs.definition: Tenders and funder intelligence for Zoho CRM. Reviewed by a person and never published.

priorities.label: P1
priorities.definition: Open to applications or always-open in-kind; relevant to India, Africa or nonprofit digital capacity. Checked often.

priorities.label: P2
priorities.definition: Relevant but narrower: one region, one theme, infrequent cycles, or another EdZola market.

priorities.label: P3
priorities.definition: Watch or intelligence only: invitation-only, paused, tender intel, low-signal aggregators.

risk_flags.label: Secondary source
risk_flags.definition: Confirm on the funder's own page before publishing.

trust_states.label: Open now
trust_states.definition: Requires current_cycle with verified_at and source_url.

trust_states.label: Historically recurring
trust_states.definition: Repeated in historical material; current applications not implied.

RFP.note: v1 'RFP' records are funders' requests for proposals, not procurement tenders.

Georgia.note: Either the US state or the country. Confirm on the funder page.

African Union.note: All African Union members, including North Africa.

v1_mappings.geography_rules: Split a v1 geography string on commas, trim each part and look it up here. Union the regions, countries and country groups. Parts marked ignore are not geography. Parts marked ambiguous, and "Not Specified", send the record to review. "*(US state)" documents the pattern used for US states and cities.
